args.reason: The old decision is a security rule: secrets come from environment variables only and are never written to .faff/. The new decision writes resolved API keys in plaintext to .faff/cache/credentials.json, which directly breaks that rule. Being gitignored only stops the file being committed; it still persists secrets on disk where backups, logs, sandbox mounts or other tools can read them. The claimed benefit (avoiding process.env reads) is negligible, since env reads are in-memory lookups and tiny next to an LLM call. A small performance gain does not justify dropping a security guarantee, so the argument does not hold.
